# Ahmed Asl

> Portfolio of Ahmed Asl, an IoT and embedded systems engineer, teaching assistant, and technical educator based in Egypt.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortfolio/): Overview of Ahmed's embedded systems, IoT, robotics, research, and teaching work.
- [Work](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortfolio/work/): Embedded firmware, robotics, IoT telemetry, secure hardware, OTA management, Flutter, and interface projects.
- [About](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortfolio/about/): Experience, university teaching, technical capabilities, publications, CV, and workshops.
- [Writing](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortfolio/writing/): Engineering field notes, Linux and cybersecurity walkthroughs, and the Learn With Me series.
- [Contact](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortfolio/contact/): Email and professional profiles.

## Areas of work

- Embedded firmware in C and C++ for ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, and AVR systems.
- IoT architecture, device connectivity, telemetry, networking, Linux, and Python.
- Robotics, sensor integration, secure access systems, and remotely operated vehicles.
- Flutter control interfaces, UI and UX design, and technical communication.
- University teaching in satellite communication, acoustics, digital and logic circuits, measurement, and sensors.

## Writing series

- OverTheWire Bandit walkthroughs: Linux, SSH, files, permissions, processes, and networking.
- Learn With Me: Linux, Python, Dart and Flutter, and Git.
